warnings: A standalone duration extension has no previous Jianpu event. (line 4, column 3, token "-") Suggestion: Attach - to a note or rest, for example 1- or 0-.

Unsupported Jianpu token member "X9" was not imported. (line 4, column 23, token "X9") Suggestion: Use 0-7, optional #/b, octave marks ' or ,, duration marks _ - ., ties ~, chords [1,3,5], and contexts such as v2: or v2@s2:.
A rest cannot be a chord member or use a tie marker. (line 4, column 26, token "0~") Suggestion: Place rest token 0 outside chord brackets and remove ~ markers.
The Jianpu tuplet ratio must use values from 1 to 64. (line 4, column 29, token "2{65:2:start}") Suggestion: Use a suffix such as {3:2:start}, {3:2}, or {3:2:stop}.
